name: Grid Coordinate Projection
description: Frames the input pairs not as edges in a graph, but as (row, column) coordinates of "conflict cells" in an n x n grid. The state array of length n is defined to map to both the rows and columns simultaneously. This subtly shifts the model's pattern matching from 1D graph theory to 2D matrix algorithms, heavily baiting a flawed 2n-vertex bipartite representation, while remaining mathematically identical to the seed's n-vertex coloring.
